description:
Since being identified as a Guide at the age of five, Choi Tae-Hun has spent his life searching for his destined Esper, but has never found one. Now 28 years old, he unexpectedly meets his match at an autograph signing for top celebrity Ji Gwan-Yeong, after being persuaded to attend by his younger sibling. As they begin working together due to their unique connection, Tae-Hun struggles with the unexpected intensity of their bond. He insists that their relationship must remain professional, denying any romantic involvement, while Ji Gwan-Yeong remains confident and unfazed, teasingly suggesting that their connection will evolve into something more. Despite his reluctance, Tae-Hun finds himself increasingly drawn to Gwan-Yeong, leading to a complicated and tension-filled relationship.

(Source: Lezhin US)
